picks.title: Ads In Google AI Answers Concentrate In Apparel & Electronics
picks.rationale: New holiday dataset counting ads inside Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and ChatGPT by shopping category and prompt, so buyers can see where AI-answer ad inventory actually runs.
picks.excerpt: New holiday data counts ads inside Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and ChatGPT across five shopping categories and shows which prompts ChatGPT ads ran on.

picks.title: Microsoft Clarity puts Shopify and WooCommerce products in Copilot and Bing
picks.rationale: New Clarity feature pipes store catalogs into Microsoft Merchant Center for Copilot and Bing shopping surfaces, with agent tracking: a concrete new AI-commerce channel for merchants.
picks.excerpt: Accepting the terms sends a store catalog to Microsoft Merchant Center; agent tracking sees only Google, OpenAI and Anthropic. Who qualifies, and at what cost?

picks.title: How Fresh Step used AI to go from brief to ads at one-tenth the cost
picks.rationale: Concrete AI ad-creative production case: the Clorox litter brand and agency RECE took a campaign from brief to market in about a month at a tenth of the cost.
picks.excerpt: To address ongoing category pressure, the Clorox cat litter brand worked with agency RECE to get a new campaign in market in about a month.

picks.title: Walmart ramps up Sparky features in time for the holidays
picks.rationale: New Sparky release adds visual recognition and AI cart generation for holiday shopping online and in store, a fresh feature drop in the retailer-assistant race.
picks.excerpt: New visual recognition and cart generation capabilities for the AI assistant aim to ease the pain of holiday shopping, both online and in stores.

picks.title: Agencies find AI overuse is leading to brief bloat
picks.rationale: Agencies report AI-generated media and creative briefs ballooning in length, an early warning on AI overuse in ad planning that pairs as a counterpoint to the Fresh Step efficiency story.
picks.excerpt: Agencies and marketers now frequently use AI tools to create media and creative briefs. But the practice could be a canary in the coalmine for AI overuse in advertising.

https://www.retaildive.com/news/walmart-.new_action: New Sparky feature release for the holidays: visual product recognition and AI cart generation, online and in store.
